documents.title: Intimation Of The Receipt Of Order Issued By Ministry Of Steel, Government Of India In Respect Of Appointment Of Shri Vivek Nishant Nath As Director (Commercial) On The Board Of The Company
Prices Of Iron Ore W.E.F. 10Th July 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: NMDC reported crossing 53 million tons of production in FY26 with an 11% growth in PAT and sales revenue reaching INR 31,000 crores. For FY27, management is targeting total production of 60 million tons, supported by operationalizing Deposit 4 and Tokisud coal mine. The company expects FY27 capex to be around INR 6,000 crores, increasing to INR 7,000-10,000 crores annually over the next 2-3 years to reach 100 million tons of capacity by the end of the decade. NMDC is also pursuing international asset acquisitions and investing INR 3,000 crores in a blending yard at Vizag to offer branded iron ore. NMDC Limited released its financial results and corporate investors' presentation for the quarter and year ended 31st March 2026.

guidance.claim: NMDC is targeting 60 million tons of production in FY27.
guidance.quote: And in that journey, I think this year we will be targeting 60 million tons, which we hope to achieve.

guidance.claim: NMDC aims to reach 100 million tons of production by the end of the decade.
guidance.quote: I believe that this sets the foundation for us to achieve 100 million tons by the end of this decade.

guidance.claim: Deposit 4 is expected to produce around 1 million ton in FY27.
guidance.quote: And this year, I think the guidance would be around 1 million ton out of Deposit 4.

guidance.claim: NMDC expects coal production guidance for Q2 to be around 0.75 million ton to 1 million ton.
guidance.quote: And our guidance for Q2 would be around 0.75 million ton to 1 million ton of coal this year.

guidance.claim: NMDC aims to achieve a Consent To Operate (CTO) capacity of around 58.8 million tons in FY27.
guidance.quote: We have asked for an enhancement of CTO in three places to about 3.32, so we'll have a CTO of around 58.8 and which is exactly what we want to do this year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects steel and iron ore prices to remain range-bound without short-term volatility.
demand_outlook.quote: I don't see much volatility in the very short term.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is not expected to be a problem for NMDC due to the low phosphorus quality of its iron ore.
demand_outlook.quote: So I don't think demand would be ever a problem for NMDC, especially the quality of ore that we produce, simply because of the phosphorus, the low phosphorus that we have.

demand_outlook.claim: Steel prices stabilized around March and April following strong upward movement from December through February.
demand_outlook.quote: I think the prices would be more or less stabilized because if you see the, I mean steel prices were very strong after December and up to December, January, February the steel prices were very, very on the, it had a -- it had a northern movement.

capex_expansion.claim: NMDC spent an all-time high capex of around INR 3,300 crores in FY26 excluding land acquisition.
capex_expansion.quote: And the capex this year has been around INR3,300 crores, which is an all-time high capex because if you leave out the land acquisition this time, and we hope that this year we'll be able to substantially increase our capex, almost double the capex now because all our expansion plans right now are on the ground.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects FY27 capex to be around INR 6,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we expect to capex of around INR6,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capex for the next 2 to 3 years is expected to be in the range of INR 7,000 crores to INR 10,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And going forward next 2, 3 years it will be in the range of INR7,000 crores to INR10,000 crores every year for the next 2, 3 years because you see most of the works are under execution and a couple of major works are just under award.

capex_expansion.claim: The board has sanctioned an investment of around INR 3,000 crores to build a blending yard at Vizag.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, the board has already sanctioned investment of around INR3,000 crores for creation of a blending yard.

capex_expansion.claim: NMDC expects to spend between INR 2,000 crores and INR 3,000 crores on acquiring global assets in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: But I think overall the capex on acquisition, the back of the envelope calculation is wherever we stand today as of today, we should be spending INR2,000 crores to INR3,000 crores on acquisition of assets abroad this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The 15 million ton slurry pipeline and Nagarnar pellet plant are expected to commission by end of June or mid-July.
capex_expansion.quote: The pellet plant and the slurry pipeline will get commissioned by end of June or maybe at best in July.

margins_costs.claim: NMDC achieved an 11% growth in PAT in FY26 despite slightly sluggish prices.
margins_costs.quote: And despite slightly sluggish prices, we've been able to achieve a PAT, an 11% growth in PAT, and all our financial indices and operating indices have been rather encouraging.

margins_costs.claim: NMDC standalone iron ore business EBITDA margin remained at 42%.
margins_costs.quote: If we take the iron ore business standalone, our EBITDA is still at 42%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins around 42% to 43% in FY27.
margins_costs.quote: and we expect to have to maintain our EBITDA at around 42 to 43% this year.

margins_costs.claim: Production costs at Bailadila were reduced from around INR 1,000 per ton to around INR 800 per ton.
margins_costs.quote: We've been able to curtail our, in fact bring down our production cost from INR1,000 odd per ton in Bailadila to around INR800 per ton this year.

orders_capacity.claim: NMDC surpassed 53 million tons of production in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We have touched 53 million tons of production, we have crossed that.

orders_capacity.claim: Deposit 4 has a peak rated mining capacity of 7 million tons.
orders_capacity.quote: then it will be ramped up to 7 million ton, which is the peak rated capacity of Deposit 4.

orders_capacity.claim: The Tokisud coal mine has a peak rated capacity of 2.3 million tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So it is the peak rated as you know in Tokisud is 2.3 million ton.

orders_capacity.claim: NMDC currently holds an Environmental Clearance (EC) capacity of 64.8 million tons and a CTO of 55.4 million tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Now we have an EC capacity of 64.8, but a CTO of around 55.4.

capital_allocation.claim: NMDC expects to fund its capex and acquisition plans through internal resources without immediate balance sheet leveraging.
capital_allocation.quote: The current visibility is that we should be able to service all our capex and acquisition requirements through internal resources.

capital_allocation.claim: NMDC acquired an 1,100-acre land parcel in Vizag to support future expansion projects.
capital_allocation.quote: It's a wonderful land parcel of around 1,100 acres. So I think all these NMDC's future expansion plan is dependent completely on the Vizag land parcel.

risks_headwinds.claim: A 30% export duty makes iron ore exports economically unviable unless exported as pellets.
risks_headwinds.quote: With a 30% export duty, it doesn't make too much of a sense to do that.

management_commitments.claim: NMDC targets 60 million tons of iron ore production in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And in that journey, I think this year we will be targeting 60 million tons, which we hope to achieve.

management_commitments.claim: NMDC plans to spend around INR 6,000 crores on capex in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: This year we expect to capex of around INR6,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: NMDC expects annual capex to be between INR 7,000 crores and INR 10,000 crores over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And going forward next 2, 3 years it will be in the range of INR7,000 crores to INR10,000 crores every year for the next 2, 3 years because you see most of the works are under execution and a couple of major works are just under award.

management_commitments.claim: The INR 3,000 crore Vizag blending yard project is expected to be completed in 2 to 2.5 years.
management_commitments.quote: One board has already sanctioned INR3,000 crores, which I think will be completed in around 2 years' time, 2.5 years' time.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
